records.claim: Birth defects can happen in any pregnancy for different reasons. Out of all babies born each year, about 3 out of 100 (3%) will have a birth defect. We look at research studies to try to understand if an exposure, like ibuprofen, might increase the chance of birth defects in a pregnancy. There are several studies that have not reported an increased chance of birth defects with ibuprofen use.
records.source_section: Does taking ibuprofen increase the chance of birth defects?
